logRotation.note: Rotation drops the oldest segment so retained run log never exceeds the limit; mechanism proven at 1 MiB scaled threshold, production initial value 100 MiB is the Client default (spike_client.py max_log_bytes).

requestTimeout.note: Per-type defaults live in Client.DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS and are applied by Client.request when timeout=None (spike_client.py); explicit timeout overrides. Recovery = command/exec/terminate kills the process group.
